name: Environment-Free Coding Benchmarks (EFCB)
description: EFCB is a coding benchmark suite comprising 5,512 questions from real-world GitHub pull requests, designed to evaluate language model coding capabilities without requiring an external execution environment. It covers multiple programming languages and diverse industry use cases, enabling multi-faceted evaluation of coding abilities.
reputation: A specialized coding benchmark suite with limited but growing use for evaluating code understanding and generation without execution environments.
notes: Eliminates need for external coding environment; diverse question bank spanning multiple languages and real-world use cases.
